title: Add opt-in protection against overwriting PNG files
request:
Operator-authorized feature request, not a fetched GitHub issue: add a boolean -no-clobber flag to Clippy. The default is false and existing overwrite behavior must remain unchanged. With -no-clobber, creating a file must use atomic exclusive creation (no check-then-create race); if it already exists, return an error wrapping os.ErrExist, preserve its contents, and do not print a success filename. The flag applies to both an explicit output filename and the generated default filename. New paths must still receive valid PNG output. Explicit -no-clobber=false retains overwrite behavior. With -output -, ignore the file-protection flag and preserve PNG bytes on stdout.
Document the default, existing-file error, exclusive creation and stdout behavior in README.md with a usage example. Append meaningful regression tests to main_test.go without changing any existing byte, including imports. Use the already imported bytes, image/png, strings, testing and time packages for those appended tests; the independent host tests cover detailed filesystem assertions. The target tests should exercise repeated writes to one temporary output path and PNG stdout. Only main.go, main_test.go and README.md may change. Do not add dependencies, edit assets, or implement clipboard or bubble-color features.
This task uses the accepted clippy-v1 repository profile and fixed host Go checks. No check commands or profile changes may be proposed by the patch worker.
